text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Under the big marron tree! You and 
I...—what?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
No... this won't do. I need to get a grip 
on myself.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Casino-san...?! Th-This is an 
emergency...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wait! Casino-san! Please wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taiki-san. What's the matter? Why in 
such a rush?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Casino-san—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eat sushi!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry. I'm not quite following...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Sushi"—as in, actual sushi? Could it be 
you're inviting me to lunch?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Conveyor belt sushi! At times 
like this, sushi is the best! Come on, 
follow me!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a spontaneous invitation is nice 
every once in a while. Okay! I'd love to 
join you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! The sushi restaurant is undergoing 
renovations!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oof... bad timing. Well then, let's give 
up for today and—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! There are other conveyor belt sushi 
spots! Onto the next one!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki-san?! Good grief, do you really 
crave sushi that badly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet as if to mock the two of them, every 
sushi joint they visited was either closed 
or on hiatus—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, what a thoroughly unlucky day. It's 
unfortunate, but how about we try another 
time?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! That won't do! Today, you definitely, 
absolutely have to eat conveyor belt 
sushi, Casino-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just imagine... the rotating lane. 
Gorgeous toppings like a parade, 
pop-tastic extras like fries and juice—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's just like the amusement park you 
were taken to as a child! How's that? 
Aren't you getting excited?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Interesting! A crossover with childhood 
memories... That's quite an exhilarating 
concept!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Okay—if you have that much passion for 
"conveyor belt sushi"!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let's not give up, Taiki-san! We've got 
this—we will definitely track one down!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, splendid. To think such a hidden gem 
was nestled right in this shopping 
district!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
With alluring offerings brought out one 
after another, I couldn't stop eating. And 
how sweet those treats were!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Conveyor belt sushi as a theme park— I 
feel like I understand what you meant now, 
Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, nice smile, Casino-san. Just seeing 
it makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The power of sushi really is great! It 
blows away all the loneliness!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Eh, 'loneliness'? ...Me? Sorry, I have no 
idea what—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What?! Because Casino-san, you were 
crying!!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that...! No, I'm sorry. That was, 
well—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been lacking sleep keeping 
track of the overseas racing situation. 
Those were just tears from holding back a 
yawn, you see...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Which means, Casino-san is not lonely 
at all? Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That is so good! I am very, very relieved!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Um, what was that saying again? 'Counting 
your Taiki chickens before they hatch'? 
Anyway, I am so happy, too!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You really do reach out your hand 
to anyone who seems lonely, don't you? 
Straightforwardly, without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course! As long as my eyes are black, I 
will never let it slip by!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Being lonely is a big NO, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taiki-san, the other day I found a 
shop that serves American-style pie. Could 
I treat you to some as thanks for the 
sushi?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great! Having it together will make it 
even more delicious!
